def invoke_bound_as_dict(self, method):
        # The caller already made its original .as_dict lookup. Preserve a
        # foreign callable as the actual operand, without a second lookup or
        # probing its metadata. The exact original method uses existing mode 6.
        original = self._definitions['as_dict']
        if (_TYPE(method) is not MethodType or method.__func__ is not original[1]
                or original[1].__code__ is not original[2]
                or not self._ordinary_attribute(method.__self__, 'as_dict')):
            return (method, (method := None))[0]()
        frame = self.prepare('as_dict', (method.__self__,))
        method = None
        return self.finish(frame)
